translation_snapshot.source:
You drink deeper from the timeline of others. Each time you apply atrophy you gain %0.1f%% spell speed per atrophy stack on the target and cause them to lose %d%% of a turn.
			The highest atrophy stack found will be used for the spell speed calculation.
translation_snapshot.target:
你进一步榨取他人的时间线。每次对目标施加衰亡效果时，目标身上的每层衰亡效果将使你获得 %0.1f%% 施法速度，同时目标将失去 %d%% 回合。
			计算施法速度增加时，会使用你周围最高层数的衰亡效果。
